description.en: A one-install online shop for a small cross-border seller, with product management built in: its own Products and Certificates tables (import an Excel or CSV product list with pictures, or edit the table), a public storefront website that lists what is on sale and takes order requests into an Orders table, and a daily shop check your agent runs and improves from your feedback.
description.zh-CN: 面向小型跨境卖家的一键开店模板，自带商品管理：店铺自己的商品表和证书表（导入含图片的 Excel 或 CSV 商品表，或直接在表里改），公开的独立站只展示在售商品、把买家的订单请求写进订单表，并附带一个每日店铺巡检，由你的智能体执行、按你的反馈持续改进。

agentPrompts: Import this product list into my shop's Products (Excel with pictures, or CSV with photos and certificates). Show me the preview first.
Open my shop: check the products it will list and the shop settings, and tell me what I still have to do before I click Go live.
Run today's shop check: read my feedback on the last report, then check products, certificates, new orders and the live site, and write one report.
Handle the new orders on my shop: check items and stock, and draft a confirmation reply for each one for me to send.
